approved_scope.title: Fix 263
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-records-009 already says the apply refuses, writing nothing more, when a file it would write already exists with other bytes, and removes the 0.5.x files only after every write is read back. The pre-write check skipped a target that differs only in case from a removed file, so on a case-sensitive file system a separate knowledge/index.md passed it. Only the check and its test change.
acceptance_criteria: On a case-sensitive file system, when knowledge/index.md already exists with other bytes beside the 0.5.x knowledge/INDEX.md, chough migrate --apply exits non-zero with refused:target-exists naming knowledge/index.md, and no file is written, removed or changed, so no receipt exists. On a case-insensitive file system, where the two names are one file, the apply still migrates as before.
